memories.name: catalogue tag placement
memories.description: Catalogue cards carry a gold tag in their lower corner.
memories.body: Place the gold collection tag in the lower right corner of each catalogue card.

memories.name: bindery drying time
memories.description: New bindings dry for three days before shelving.
memories.body: Leave a newly bound folio on the drying rack for seventy two hours before shelving it.

memories.name: scanner lid alignment
memories.description: A lid alignment error requires the scanner spacer.
memories.body: When the folio scanner shows LID_ALIGN, fit the blue spacer before the next scan.
